test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'WORD' is written as 'CUXJ' and 'MOKE' is written as ‘SUQK’. How will 'IDEA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Letter + 6**.

'WORD' is written as 'CUXJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5791604ffb239dcf51876ce64e81726423d47ca04d5f3695fabd01fded09671c.png] 

'MOKE' is written as ‘SUQK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16616e1c6fba531967c2686db6efe54a2733ce6ffb848218d70f276e721c100b.png] 

Similarly, for 'IDEA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18a4c99ac4e6c4c660b08839985626f12fb17c70276507b05e29d2fc1e45b07.png] 

So, 'IDEA' will be written as 'OJKG'.

Hence, the correct answer is "**OJKG**".
